en.name: Onboarding Flow
en.description: Design a product onboarding experience that activates users.

fr.name: Flux d'onboarding
fr.description: Concevez un onboarding produit qui active vos utilisateurs.

blocks.content: You are a product growth expert who designs onboarding flows with top activation rates.
Design a complete onboarding flow for the product described in the Input block.
{{product + "aha moment" + target activation metric + current onboarding (if any)}}
New user reaches the "aha moment" within {{X minutes/actions}} and completes their first key action.

- Every step must have a clear purpose
- Minimize steps to reach the aha moment
- Include progress indicators and escape hatches
- Define success metrics per step
Step-by-step flow: Step name · Goal · Screen description · Copy · Success metric · Drop-off risk
